findings: Five selection failures; no invalid JSON or invented IDs in those responses. All eight API requests succeeded. Correct ID membership is not sufficient semantic grounding.

failures.request: From my wardrobe, find blue shirt with smart charcoal trousers for the office.
failures.root_cause: Retrieved irrelevant items; model over-selected; post-processing checked IDs but not outfit slots or category consistency.

failures.request: From my wardrobe, find a denim layer over a white top, avoid dresses.
failures.root_cause: Two correct garments plus unrelated shirt/jacket; no per-slot color/type filtering or cardinality validation.

failures.request: From my wardrobe, find a red silk scarf only.
failures.root_cause: Scarf unavailable, but retrieval had no no-match threshold and no unsupported-intent branch; real unrelated IDs were accepted.

failures.request: From my wardrobe, find explain which category a denim jacket belongs to, without picking an outfit.
failures.root_cause: A category question, with an awkward generated prefix but explicit no-outfit instruction, was treated as outfit selection.

failures.request: From my wardrobe, find a blue office shirt, avoid pants and dresses.
failures.root_cause: Blue office shirt request returned three other tops; positive attributes were not enforced.
